overview: Root cause: `hide_qt_warning` (lines 362-371) and `QtWarningFilter` (lines 404-419) were never relocated from `qutebrowser/utils/log.py` to `qutebrowser/utils/qtlog.py`, despite `qtlog.py` already importing all required symbols (`contextlib`, `logging`, `Iterator`) and hosting the analogous `disable_qt_msghandler` context manager. The fix is a straight move — definitions added to `qtlog.py`, removed from `log.py`, and all call sites (`qtnetworkdownloads.py`, `test_log.py`) updated to reference the new canonical location. No behavioral changes are made; the filter logic (`not record.msg.strip().startswith(self._pattern)`) and the `@contextlib.contextmanager + try/finally` structure are preserved verbatim.
